Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Build & CI Pipeline (dotnet build / GitHub Actions)
Content:
## Build Pipeline Flow

Chat "build a house" -> LlmChatInterpreter -> IntentDraft(blueprint="house") -> IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest -> resolves via BlueprintAliases["house"]="small-house" -> BuildGoalRequest("small-house") -> GoalFactory.CreateAsync("Build:small-house") -> MemorySmithBlueprintRepository.GetAsync("small-house") -> finds blueprints/small-house.md -> BuildGoal -> HtnPlanner -> BuildGoalDecomposer -> HtnTaskLibrary.DecomposeBuild -> PlaceBlock, CraftItem, etc.

## Known Issues (Sprint 41 - FIXED)

### Blueprint alias resolution missing from LLM path

The BlueprintAliases dictionary ("house" -> "small-house", etc.) existed only in ChatInterpreter.cs (the fast-path non-LLM interpreter). The LlmChatInterpreter (LLM path) didn't resolve aliases. When the LLM returned "blueprint": "house", IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest passed "house" directly to GoalFactory, which looked for "blueprints/house" (doesn't exist) instead of "blueprints/small-house" (exists at Data/Pages/blueprints/small-house.md).

Fix: Added BlueprintAliases dictionary to IntentManager.cs with ResolveBlueprint() applied before creating BuildGoalRequest.

### Insufficient logging in build pipeline

Failures were silent at multiple stages:
- IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest returning null was not logged
- GoalFactory blueprint lookup failure had no log line
- MemorySmithBlueprintRepository.GetAsync didn't log which fallbacks succeeded/failed

Fix: Added logging at each stage:
- HandleChatEventAsync logs intent draft fields + goal request creation result
- GoalFactory logs warning when blueprint not found, including slug path hint
- MemorySmithBlueprintRepository logs each fallback (gateway, local, search) with success/failure

## MSBuild & .slnx

- **Solution format:** .slnx (MSBuild solution XML) — 10 projects
- **Target:** net10.0, C# 14 (latest)
- **TreatWarningsAsErrors=true** in Directory.Build.props — all warnings are build errors
- **NU1903** (NuGet transitive advisory) exempted via WarningsNotAsErrors — fully visible in output but doesn't break build
- **Nullable enabled**, implicit usings enabled, file-scoped namespaces

### Directory.Build.props Policy

```xml
<Project>
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
    <!-- NU1903 is NOT suppressed; it is a policy exemption for transitive
         dependency advisories that cannot be fixed at our layer -->
    <WarningsNotAsErrors>NU1903</WarningsNotAsErrors>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>
```

### CopilotSkipCliDownload Flag

`-p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true` must be passed to both `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` in CI. This prevents the Copilot CLI NuGet package from attempting to download the GitHub Copilot CLI binary during restore, which fails in CI environments without VS Code.

### --no-build on Test

`--no-build` is used on the test step to prevent rebuild (build already happened in the previous step with `--no-restore`). This saves ~30s per CI run.

## Chat-to-Execution Pipeline (for reference)

Chat "build a house" → LlmChatInterpreter → IntentDraft(blueprint="house") → IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest → resolves via BlueprintAliases["house"]="small-house" → BuildGoalRequest("small-house") → GoalFactory.CreateAsync("Build:small-house") → MemorySmithBlueprintRepository.GetAsync("small-house") → finds Data/Pages/blueprints/small-house.md → BuildGoal → HtnPlanner → BuildGoalDecomposer → HtnTaskLibrary.DecomposeBuild → PlaceBlock, CraftItem, etc.

## Known Issues (Sprint 41 — FIXED: Blueprint alias resolution, Logging)

### Blueprint alias resolution missing from LLM path
The BlueprintAliases dictionary ("house" → "small-house", etc.) existed only in ChatInterpreter.cs (fast-path non-LLM interpreter). LlmChatInterpreter (LLM path) didn't resolve aliases. Fix: Added BlueprintAliases dictionary to IntentManager.cs with ResolveBlueprint() applied before creating BuildGoalRequest.

### Insufficient logging in build pipeline
Failures were silent at multiple stages. Fix: Added logging at IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest, GoalFactory blueprint lookup, and MemorySmithBlueprintRepository fallback stages.

### Files Changed (Sprint 41)
- Agent.Planning/IntentManager.cs — BlueprintAliases + ResolveBlueprint()
- Agent.Memory/MemorySmithBlueprintRepository.cs — ILogger + logging at each lookup stage
- Agent.Memory/Agent.Memory.csproj — added Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions
- Agent.Planning/GoalFactory.cs — logging when blueprint not found
- WebUI.Blazor/AgentBackgroundService.cs — logging in HandleChatEventAsync
- WebUI.Blazor/Program.cs — pass logger to MemorySmithBlueprintRepository
- Agent.Planning/LlmChatInterpreter.cs — build intent guidance in system prompt
